title: The Boot and the Big Fish
lines: Pam and Ben went to the sea with Dad.
They got in a blue boat by the shore.
The moon was bright on the cool sea.
Dad let them sit up on the seat.
Pam had a net, and Ben had his boots on.
They ate sweet fruit and had cool tea.
A big gray fish came up to look at them.
Ben shook so much at the sight of it.
Dad held Ben as one boot fell in the sea!
The fish took the boot and swam off fast.
Ben yelled, and Pam held up the big net.
She did try, but the fish was too fast.
Then Pam had a plan. She held up the fruit.
She let a bit of it drop in the sea.
The fish came back up for the sweet fruit.
It let go of the boot at last.
Ben got the boot back with the net.
One boot was wet, but he had both.

questions.ask: What did they have to eat in the boat?
questions.listenFor: Sweet fruit and cool tea. Find the line with the word "ate" in it.

questions.ask: How did Pam get the fish to let go of the boot?
questions.listenFor: She let a bit of fruit drop in. The net had not worked, as the fish was too fast.

questions.ask: What do you think the fish did next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any idea is fine. Ask what in the story made them think so.
